title: Surcharge Rights and Supplier Failure Protection: Conditions for Vacation Package Products
content:
These conditions publish, for each of the Vacation Package Products, whether a fuel or currency surcharge may be added after booking at all, the percentage of the package price a surcharge must exceed before the party may cancel without penalty, the calendar days before departure by which a surcharge must be notified, and whether the package carries financial protection against supplier failure.

**1. Whether a surcharge may be added.** A surcharge may be added after booking only on a product published as allowing one.

**2. The threshold share.** The percentage published against the product booked is the share of the package price a surcharge must exceed.

**3. Notice distance.** A surcharge must be notified at least the number of calendar days before departure published against the product booked.

**4. Financial protection.** Financial protection against supplier failure is carried as published against the product booked.

| Product | Surcharge after booking | Threshold share of the package price | Notice before departure | Financial protection against supplier failure |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Value Bundle Package | allowed | 8 per cent | 30 calendar days | carried |
| Flex Bundle Package | allowed | 8 per cent | 30 calendar days | carried |
| All-Inclusive Resort Package | allowed | 8 per cent | 30 calendar days | carried |
| Escorted Tour Package | allowed | 10 per cent | 45 calendar days | carried |
| Ocean Cruise Package | allowed | 10 per cent | 60 calendar days | carried |
| Luxury Collection Package | not allowed | 0 per cent | 0 calendar days | carried |

**5. Reading the entries together.** Five of the six products allow a surcharge after booking; the Luxury Collection Package allows none, and its threshold and notice figures accordingly stand at nil, there being no surcharge for them to qualify. Among the five that do allow one, the threshold share stands at 8 per cent on the three lowest-ranked products and at 10 per cent on the Escorted Tour Package and the Ocean Cruise Package, while the notice distance lengthens from 30 calendar days through 45 to 60. Financial protection against supplier failure is carried on every one of the six Vacation Package Products without exception.
